title: Letter to John Thornton and Others, 25 June 1834
source_note: JS, Letter, Rush Creek, Clay Co., MO, to John Thornton, Alexander Doniphan, and David R. Atchison, [Clay Co., MO], 25 June 1834. Featured version copied [4–6 Aug. 1843]1 in JS History, vol. A-1, 505–506; handwriting of Willard Richards; CHL. Includes redactions.
